mapper.select: SELECT i.name FROM advisor a JOIN instructor i ON a.i_id = i.ID WHERE a.s_id = #{id}
SELECT i.ID AS i_id, i.name, i.dept_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM advisor a2 WHERE a2.i_id = i.ID) AS advisee_count FROM advisor a JOIN instructor i ON a.i_id = i.ID WHERE a.s_id = #{id}

SELECT t.course_id, t.sec_id, t.semester, t.year, c.title, c.credits, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(i.name SEPARATOR '、') FROM teaches th JOIN instructor i ON th.ID = i.ID WHERE th.course_id = t.course_id AND th.sec_id = t.sec_id AND th.semester = t.semester AND th.year = t.year) AS instructor_names, s.time_slot_id, s.building, s.room_number, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM takes k WHERE k.course_id = t.course_id AND k.sec_id = t.sec_id AND k.semester = t.semester AND k.year = t.year) AS enrolled, cl.capacity, t.grade FROM takes t JOIN section s ON t.course_id = s.course_id AND t.sec_id = s.sec_id AND t.semester = s.semester AND t.year = s.year JOIN course c ON t.course_id = c.course_id LEFT JOIN classroom cl ON s.building = cl.building AND s.room_number = cl.room_number WHERE t.ID = #{id} ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.semester, t.course_id
SELECT t.course_id, c.title, c.credits, t.semester, t.year, t.grade FROM takes t JOIN course c ON t.course_id = c.course_id WHERE t.ID = #{id} ORDER BY t.year, t.semester, t.course_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM takes t JOIN course c ON t.course_id = c.course_id WHERE t.ID = #{id}

SELECT t.course_id, c.title, c.credits, t.semester, t.year, t.grade, gp.point AS grade_point FROM takes t JOIN course c ON t.course_id = c.course_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT 'A+' AS grade, 4.3 AS point UNION ALL SELECT 'A', 4.0 UNION ALL SELECT 'A-', 3.7 UNION ALL SELECT 'B+', 3.3 UNION ALL SELECT 'B', 3.0 UNION ALL SELECT 'B-', 2.7 UNION ALL SELECT 'C+', 2.3 UNION ALL SELECT 'C', 2.0 UNION ALL SELECT 'C-', 1.7 UNION ALL SELECT 'D+', 1.3 UNION ALL SELECT 'D', 1.0 UNION ALL SELECT 'F', 0.0 ) gp ON gp.grade = t.grade WHERE t.ID = #{id} ORDER BY t.year, t.semester, t.course_id LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN gp.point IS NOT NULL AND t.grade != 'F' THEN c.credits ELSE 0 END), 0) AS earned_credits, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN gp.point IS NOT NULL THEN gp.point * c.credits ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_points, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN gp.point IS NOT NULL THEN c.credits ELSE 0 END), 0) AS graded_credits FROM takes t JOIN course c ON t.course_id = c.course_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT 'A+' AS grade, 4.3 AS point UNION ALL SELECT 'A', 4.0 UNION ALL SELECT 'A-', 3.7 UNION ALL SELECT 'B+', 3.3 UNION ALL SELECT 'B', 3.0 UNION ALL SELECT 'B-', 2.7 UNION ALL SELECT 'C+', 2.3 UNION ALL SELECT 'C', 2.0 UNION ALL SELECT 'C-', 1.7 UNION ALL SELECT 'D+', 1.3 UNION ALL SELECT 'D', 1.0 UNION ALL SELECT 'F', 0.0 ) gp ON gp.grade = t.grade WHERE t.ID = #{id}

SELECT nts.day, nts.start_time, nts.end_time FROM takes t JOIN section s ON t.course_id = s.course_id AND t.sec_id = s.sec_id AND t.semester = s.semester AND t.year = s.year JOIN time_slot mts ON mts.time_slot_id = s.time_slot_id JOIN time_slot nts ON nts.time_slot_id = #{timeSlotId} WHERE t.ID = #{id} AND t.semester = #{semester} AND t.year = #{year} AND mts.day = nts.day AND mts.start_time < nts.end_time AND nts.start_time < mts.end_time LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT year FROM section ORDER BY year DESC
SELECT ID AS id, name, dept_name, tot_cred FROM student ORDER BY ID
mapper.update: UPDATE student s SET tot_cred = (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(c.credits), 0) FROM takes t JOIN course c ON t.course_id = c.course_id WHERE t.ID = s.ID AND t.grade IS NOT NULL AND t.grade != 'F') WHERE s.ID = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student (ID, name, dept_name, tot_cred) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{deptName}, #{totCred})
